in_marathi.name: Poorva
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Old, Ancient, First
in_marathi.long_meaning: Poorva हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Poorva means old, ancient, and first. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'purva' which means 'before' or 'earlier'. This name is often given to a child born before a sibling or as a mark of respect to an elder in the family. It is also a name for the first month of the lunar year in Hindu culture. Poorva is a name that signifies the beginning of something new and the progression towards the future.
